summary: Practise award risk reviews, cost testing, procurement evidence and closeout across multiple donors. Explore the five-day course and syllabus.
lede: Multi-donor grant and subaward management helps teams turn differing award terms into practical controls. It is for NGO finance, grants, programme, and subaward professionals who administer, monitor, or review donor-funded awards. Participants compare award obligations, assess subrecipient risk, test allowable costs and allocations, and document procurement, modifications, closeout, and audit evidence using award matrices and risk registers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who administer, monitor, or independently review grants and subawards funded by multiple donors. It suits professionals who need to translate distinct award terms into traceable operational controls.
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting finance, grants, programme delivery, procurement, compliance, or audit work in a donor-funded organization is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with budgets and financial records; exercises use spreadsheet-based templates and sample award information.
